images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of LynnReal-Hand. Stage I learns a hand-conditioned bidirectional world model with hand-aware supervision. Stage II learns few-step causal flow maps through teacher forcing with clean history. Stage III applies dual-score distillation to self-generated rollouts: high-noise video supervision guides interaction dynamics, while background-masked image supervision guides appearance. Ultra-Fast-VAE supports streaming decoding. Panels (a)–(c) show the attention masks: colored blocks permit attention, gray/×\timesblocks mask it (rows: queries; columns: keys).

Figure 3:Score-direction probes at a shared rollout time. Columns: GT, inputxx, teacher/critic clean predictions, decodedx−Δx-\Delta, and channel-RMS ofΔ=Df−Dr\Delta=D_{f}-D_{r}. Higher video noise emphasizes hand-local corrections; image guidance changes background boundaries. Video/image inputs useZθZ_{\theta}/B⁡(Zθ)B(Z_{\theta}), decoded in their respective spaces. Unit steps precede DMD normalization and image masking; heatmap scales are fixed per branch (AppendixD.1).

Figure 4:Matched hand–object details from five interactions. Ours: Ultra-Fast-VAE. Values are PSNR (dB) on the displayed crops. Tiny-H3 smooths fine textures and object edges, while ours remains close to Native H3 and Light-VAE. Full-frame comparisons: AppendixE.4.

Figure 6:Hand-conditioned interaction in everyday scenes. Each row follows one demo sequence. Upper-right insets show the aligned MANO hand conditions within the generated LynnReal-Hand-Base frames. Overlaid WASD and rotation controls visualize the supplied camera motion, following Figure5; time progresses left to right. The strips cover fishing, cloth folding, cooking, ornament painting, violin playing, and bird interaction.

Figure 7:Selected imaginative interactions generated by LynnReal-Hand-Base. Each row follows one saved demo video, from manipulating luminous forms and projected layouts to tracing a portal and writing on paper. Only generated outputs are shown; frame times refer to the original videos.
